en.headline: Gelato market returns to PMQ from Friday to Sunday
en.dek: Ciao Gelato Fest lists a second weekend at PMQ on Aberdeen Street, with free entry, 20 stalls and a HK$188 pass for six mini cups.
body: Ciao Gelato Fest is due back at PMQ in Central from Friday to Sunday, 9 to 11 October, after a first run over the National Day weekend. Organisers have placed the market at 35 Aberdeen Street.

The listing describes 20 gelato brands from Hong Kong, Macau, Italy and Portugal, and more than 30 flavours made for the event. Admission is free. A tasting pass priced at HK$188 can be bought on site and exchanged for six mini portions at designated stalls.

Listed flavours include a caviar gelato, a garlic and coriander gelato, and a Hong Kong-style French toast gelato made with a bakery. Opening hours have been given differently in listings, so visitors should check the venue notice on the day.
The market is a ticketed-optional food event rather than a public programme of the Leisure and Cultural Services Department.

zh.headline: 意式雪糕市集周五至日再在元創方舉行
zh.dek: Ciao Gelato Fest 公布第二個周末回到鴨巴甸街元創方，入場免費，約20個品牌設檔，188元套票可換六杯迷你雪糕。
body: 意式雪糕市集 Ciao Gelato Fest 將於10月9日至11日，即星期五至日，再到中環元創方。國慶假期周末已辦過一場，場地在鴨巴甸街35號。
主辦單位列出約20個來自香港、澳門、意大利和葡萄牙的品牌，以及逾30款為活動準備的口味。入場免費。現場可買188元試食套票，在指定攤檔換六杯迷你份量。
已公布的口味包括魚子醬、蒜蓉芸茜，以及與餅店合作的港式西多士雪糕。各渠道列出的開放時間並不一致，到場時間宜以場地當日告示為準。
這是飲食市集，不是康文署的公眾節目。
